Macrons

Consonantal i

Construction, trades & building materials

insulation board noun

also panel, insulation panel, EPS, expanded polystyrene

our formation

tabula ad calōrem retinendum

a board for retaining heat

Our functional description. For an individual panel, tabula, tabulae f. is a useful broad noun; the precise material should be specified separately.

Examples

  • Nōlī hanc tabulam perforāre.

    Don’t make holes in this board.composed

Other words

  • tabula spūmea; tabulae spūmeae f. — EPS insulation board (expanded polystyrene)

    also used · our formation

    Our working formation, not an attested term, built on classical spūmeus, spūmea, spūmeum “foamy” (Vergil, Ovid, Pliny). Gloss: tabula levissima ex māteriā artificiōsā spūmeā facta, quae parietibus forīs affīgitur, ut domus hieme calōrem retineat et aestāte frīgus. The common boards on site are black, graphite EPS, not white.

See also insulation, insulate, board.

SourcesLewis & Short: tabula · Lewis & Short: calor · Lewis & Short: perforo · Lewis & Short: spumeus

The example sentence marked “composed” is ours.
